**Qualifier for n77:** `Surface.draw()` requests `drawFrame(true)`; it does not guarantee synchronous presentation on every backend. Metal waits for the command buffer and sets layer contents synchronously. OpenGL explicitly ignores `sync`, exports the completed frame, and requests a toolkit redraw (`src/renderer/opengl/Frame.zig:51-90`).
